description: Large Landfill Sites (Historical data) is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Conservation and Parks. Data with the following information for large landfills: landfill capacity fill rates estimated remaining capacity engineering designs reporting and monitoring details This dataset was last updated in 2014 and contains out of date information. It has been replaced by the Ontario landfills dataset. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Conservation and Parks. Its tags are Economy and Business, Environment and Natural Resources, Environment and energy, Environnement et richesses naturelles, Environnement et énergie. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLS. The portal shows 2023-05-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
